references.role: IDENTITY AND CROP LOCK: the owner-approved Mahmut composed bust; copy its face, hair, stubble, eyes, armour, star and empty socket, cloak, pose, framing, lighting and flat green background exactly and change nothing except what the prompt names

prompt:
Deliverable: the same visual-novel bust of Mahmut as in reference image 1, redrawn once with a single changed expression, portrait 2:3, one image only.
IDENTITY AND CROP LOCK: Mahmut, an adult man aged 28. Keep exactly the face, short dark messy hair, stubble, brown eyes, dark worn mismatched half-plate with the star on the breastplate and the empty socket above it, tattered oxblood cloak, three-quarter pose, crop, camera distance, eye line (about 27% from the top), lighting, warm amber rim light from the left and flat pure #00FF00 background of reference image 1, aligned with it. The silhouette of the hair, shoulders and cloak stays identical; both hands stay outside the frame.
CHANGE ONLY THE EXPRESSION, protective: the brow is lowered and drawn together slightly, the jaw is set, the eyes are hard and level and look straight at the camera, the chin is tucked down a few degrees; the mouth is closed with firm pressure. Resolve and readiness, quiet determination rather than rage. Everything outside the eyes, brows, mouth and a head tilt of at most five degrees is unchanged.
STYLE: painterly dark gothic anime light-novel illustration, thin soft plum-black linework, soft cel shading on the skin, painterly matte cloth, weathered worn dull metal, visible brush grain, no gloss, exactly the rendering of reference image 1.
TECHNICAL: flat pure #00FF00 background, one flat colour from edge to edge with no gradient, shadow or glow; crisp hard silhouette edges; no green on the subject; text-free.
Do not add: text, letters, logos, watermark, border, a second person, a different face, new props, changes of costume or crop.
notes: mahmut_portraits group, stage 2 of 2 (expression edit). DEPENDS on the owner-approved mahmut_vn_composed: reference/approved/mahmut_vn_composed.png does not exist until that approval gate runs, so a gen_image dry run fails with ENOENT until then (validateSpec passes).
